text: The Dynaslope Project integrates scientific instrumentation and analytics with community engagement to operationalize landslide early warning. It uses rainfall and ground movement sensors to monitor landslide precursors, with data relayed in near-real-time to PHIVOLCS centers. The project employs calibrated rainfall thresholds and ground-deformation triggers to issue tiered alerts, ensuring timely and actionable warnings for communities. Its hazard maps are recognized as authoritative references for scientific assessments and local decision-making.

metadata.solution_name: Development of Philippine Nationwide Operational Landslide Monitoring and Warning System — DOST–PHIVOLCS Dynaslope Project
